The registry is named FEAT_SITUATIONAL/SituationalBonus and every existing entry is a bonus, so listing a penalty is an owner call. I have included it so the information is not lost.
evidence: "the wearer gains a +1 item bonus to Nature checks to Command an Animal, which increases to +2 if the animal is a bear"; and "takes a –1 item penalty to all Diplomacy checks to Gather Information or Make an Impression if they go more than 5 days inside a large town or city without spending at least 4 hours in the wilderness."

name: Heartblood Ring
question: Same penalty-in-a-bonus-registry question as Ursine Avenger Hood, and: should staged boons/afflictions (heartblood, phoenix cinder, void fragment) be excluded from this registry entirely until the app can track which stage the character is in?
evidence: Stage 1: "you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws (or any other defense) against death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, and sleep." Purging: "a dose of heartblood imposes a –2 status penalty to your saving throws against the powers of the vampire who created it."

Stage 2: "If any creatures can be detected by your thoughtsense, you take a –1 penalty to Perception checks"; stage 3: "The mental noise increases the penalty to Perception to –2."

name: Corruption Cassock
question: This is a cursed item whose printed bonus is a deliberate lie: the wearer BELIEVES they have +2 Religion / +1 divine skill and the GM secretly removes it. Should the sheet (a) show the fake bonus as if real, preserving the trap, (b) show nothing, or (c) show it flagged as cursed and spoil the GM's secret? That is an app-owner call about how cursed items are surfaced, not something the text decides.
evidence: "While you remain loyal to another deity, you believe the cassock grants you a +2 item bonus to Religion checks and a +1 item bonus to the divine skill of the deity to whom you believe the cassock is dedicated. It does neither… If you convert to following the cassock's true unholy deity, however, these bonuses function normally for you."

question: Cursed-item display policy, same as Corruption Cassock: should the sheet render the illusory +1 Diplomacy bonus the player thinks they have, show nothing, or show it labelled as cursed? Note the item also NEGATES real +1 item bonuses to Diplomacy from other sources, which is a suppression rule this registry cannot express.
evidence: "These wire-rim glasses appear to be Glasses of Sociability, making you think they grant a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy when they grant none."
